title: Rainy Window Ambience | 90 Minutes of Gentle Rain, No Thunder or Music
description: A steady, gentle rain soundscape with soft blue lights beyond an illustrated window. Calm and even the whole way through.

title: Mountain Sunset Meditation Music | 45 Minutes of Soft Ambient Tones
description: Soft sustained chords and occasional glass-like notes against layered illustrated mountain ridges. An unhurried evening session without voiceover.

title: Aurora Meditation Ambience | 30 Minutes of Gentle Ambient Music
description: Slow layered tones and soft glass-like notes accompany original northern-lights artwork. A quiet half-hour pause, without spoken guidance.

title: Crackling Campfire Sounds 🔥 [No Ads] | 1 Hour of Fire Crackling for Sleep & Relaxation
description: A sequence of campfire scenes with a warm, steady fire-crackle soundscape. Calm and even, with soft transitions between scenes.

title: Deep Space Sleep Ambience | 2 Hours of Soft Cosmic Drone & Dimmed Visuals
description: A low, slowly evolving cosmic drone beneath a dark illustrated star field. The picture gradually dims between minutes 10 and 30.

title: 8 Hours of Deep Space Sleep Sounds | Cosmic Drone for Sleeping, No Talking
description: Slow cosmic drift and a soft, evolving space drone. The picture gradually dims between 10 and 40 minutes and the audio gently softens. The screen stays dim rather than going fully black.

title: Morning Forest Sounds | 1 Hour of Birdsong & Gentle Wind, No Music
description: Light birdsong and a breeze through the trees, with an illustrated misty forest. An unhurried start to the day.

title: Space Ambience for Focus | 1 Hour of Calm Cosmic Music, No Talking
description: An evolving space drone with delicate upper tones and slow star-field visuals. A continuous hour for focused work, reading or winding down.

title: Night Forest Ambience | 90 Minutes of Crickets & Soft Wind, No Music
description: A quiet nighttime mix of insect calls and gentle wind beneath a moonlit illustrated canopy. No thunder, no narration, no music.

title: Forest Rain & Distant Thunder | 90 Minutes of Storm Ambience, No Music
description: A deeper rain bed, moving leaves and occasional distant thunder in an illustrated forest. A little more texture than steady rain.

title: Gentle Wind in the Trees | 45 Minutes of Golden Forest Ambience
description: Soft rustling leaves with sparse bird calls and warm illustrated forest scenes. A lighter soundscape for an afternoon break.

title: Rain Sounds for Reading & Study | 1 Hour, No Music, No Timer Bells
description: A warm illustrated window, continuous rain and occasional quiet droplets. A full, uninterrupted hour for a book, study session or a calmer desk.
